raw_segments.text: He lay in prison very ill, during the whole interval between his committal for trial and
the coming round of the sessions.
He had broken two ribs, they had wounded one of his lungs, and he breathed with great pain
It was a consequence of his hurt that he spoke so low as to be scarcely audible, therefore
But he was ever ready to listen to me, and it became the first duty of my life to say
to him, and read to him, what I knew he ought to hear.
